name: ALPS YT9216 family (YT9216BJ and related)
about: Budget units whose build strings name YT9216 (for example YT9216BJ). 'ALPS' is MediaTek's default brand string and says nothing about the board on its own. Hardware varies a lot between units sold under the same name.
limitations: Chipset not confirmed: write-ups link the family to the Autochips/MediaTek 8227L platform, but this is not verified.
No YT9216 unit has been tested with CleanYourHeadUnit yet.
restore_notes: Only pm disable-user is used; pm enable brings every package back.
